pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pStores a carried inventory. When installed, its contents remain part of the Flawless Calculator component.$p$(l)Use$()$pOpen it, place items, close it, and check the same contents after selecting another module. It cannot be nested indiscriminately inside container items.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/installing)Using modules inside a Flawless Calculator$()$pObtain this module: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.
